description: Confirm and pin POST /api/assessments as the amend mechanism. Creating an assessment for a pitch that already has one appends a NEW row with version = previous latest + 1; it never mutates or overwrites a prior version. assessor_id is set to the acting user and assessment_date is taken from the request. Criteria scores are validated to the 1-5 range. admin+assessor may create; viewer 403; all authenticated roles may list/read. There is no PATCH/PUT/DELETE for assessments (versioning is the only amendment path). The list endpoint returns only the latest version per pitch when called without a filter, but returns all versions when filtering by pitch_id (for version history views).
expectedBehavior: POST for a pitch with an existing assessment returns 200 with version = previous latest + 1; the prior row is unchanged on a subsequent GET
The created version's assessor_id is the acting user and assessment_date is the supplied date
A score outside 1-5 (e.g. 0 or 6) returns 422 and creates no new version
Posting with a pitch_id different from the latest version's pitch_id returns 422 and creates no new version
viewer POST -> 403; unauthenticated -> 401; GET list/detail -> 200 for admin/assessor/viewer
No update or delete endpoint exists for assessments
GET /api/assessments (no filter) returns only the latest version per pitch
GET /api/assessments?pitch_id={id} returns all versions for that pitch (for history)
verificationSteps: cd backend && pytest tests/test_assessments.py -k 'version or create or rbac or validation or latest or filter'

description: On AssessmentDetailPage (and/or the pitch view), add an 'Amend' / 'New version' affordance (admin+assessor only) that opens the assessment form pre-filled from the current latest version, and on save POSTs to /api/assessments to create the next version, then shows the new version. The pitch field is disabled/read-only when amending (assessments cannot be reassigned to different pitches). Render the full version history (newest first) with the latest marked as current and every prior version openable and read-only. The assessments list (/assessments) shows only the latest version per pitch, updating in-place when amended; prior versions are archived but remain accessible in the detail view. Hide the amend control for viewers.
expectedBehavior: Detail view shows an amend/new-version control for admin/assessor and hides it for viewer
The amend form is pre-filled from the current latest version with pitch field disabled; saving calls api.post('/assessments', ...) and shows the incremented version
The version-history list shows all versions newest-first with the current one marked; prior versions open read-only
The assessments list shows each pitch once with its latest assessment; amending updates that row in-place without creating a new list entry
Cancelling the amend form makes no api.post call

description: Fix SearchPage result navigation. The /api/search response tags each result with a singular type ('pitch', 'organisation', 'contact', 'meeting', 'assessment'); the click handler currently mis-maps the pitch type to an empty basePath, so selecting a pitch navigates to '/' (dashboard). Map each result type to its correct detail route (pitch -> /pitches/{id}, organisation -> /organisations/{id}, contact -> /contacts/{id}, meeting -> /meetings/{id}, assessment -> /assessments/{id}) so no result type falls through to the dashboard.
expectedBehavior: Clicking a pitch search result navigates to /pitches/{id} and renders that pitch, not the dashboard
Clicking a result of any other type navigates to that type's detail route
No result type resolves to an empty basePath or the catch-all/dashboard route

description: Confirm and pin PATCH /api/contacts/{id} as a partial update over ContactUpdate. description: Add a User Management page at /admin/users (admin only) where admins can view all users with their email, role, and status, and edit each user's role. The role can be changed via a dropdown select in an inline edit form (Save/Cancel buttons), and changes are persisted via PATCH /api/users/{id}. The page reflects role changes in the table in-place after successful save.
expectedBehavior: UsersPage displays a table with all users, their email, role, and status
Each user row has an Edit button that opens an inline form with a role dropdown
The role dropdown allows selecting admin, assessor, or viewer
Save button calls PATCH /api/users/{id} with the new role and updates the row on success
Cancel button closes the edit form without making any API call
API errors are displayed as an error message without losing the edit state
The page is admin-only (protected by AdminRoute component)
